source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: The three basic handshake messages are SYN, ___, and ACK.
hints: Both flags are set in the middle message.
questions.explanation: The server acknowledges the client SYN and supplies its own initial sequence.

source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: SYN consumes ___ sequence number even without application data.
questions.explanation: Both SYN and FIN consume one sequence position.

source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: Sequence 1001 carrying 26 bytes can be cumulatively acknowledged with ___.

source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: The receive window abbreviation is ___ and the congestion window abbreviation is ___.
questions.explanation: The two windows constrain different resources.

source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: The minimum TCP header is ___ bytes.
questions.explanation: Options can increase the header length.

source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: TCP acknowledgment numbers count ___ rather than whole SMTP messages.
hints: Units of the stream sequence space.
questions.explanation: All TCP payload bytes participate, including application commands and replies.

source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: A TCP endpoint with no more bytes to send can transmit ___.
questions.explanation: FIN ends one sending direction and consumes a sequence number.

source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: An abrupt TCP connection termination can use the ___ flag.
questions.explanation: RST differs from an orderly FIN exchange.

source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: The active closer normally waits in the ___ state.
hints: The state handles delayed traffic and final ACK recovery.
questions.explanation: TIME-WAIT is part of orderly connection closure.

source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: With rwnd 32 KiB and cwnd 12 KiB, the simplified limit on outstanding bytes is ___ KiB.
questions.explanation: The send limit must respect both receive and congestion windows.

source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: The TCP checksum uses an IP-address ___ that is not transmitted as a separate layer header.
questions.explanation: The pseudoheader includes addressing, protocol, and TCP length.

source.section: Section 7 — TCP connection reliability and control

questions.sentence: MSS stands for maximum ___ size and describes TCP payload capacity, not a complete Ethernet frame.
questions.explanation: MSS is a payload sizing constraint and is separate from link MTU.
